annotations.title: Tokens FOMO traders are gathering on

description: Tokens that several different traders on the FOMO app bought inside a window (default 3 traders in 60 minutes), on Robinhood Chain and Solana, most traders first. Each row has the latest and the first buy seen with their market caps, how many of those traders are still in, and pumppill_read, PumpPill's own risk answer for the token ('none stored' is a gap, not a clean bill). FOMO's feed shows large buys only: this counts FOMO users, not all buyers, and carries no trade sizes.
name: fomo_gathering
